info.name: Pioneer DDJ-XP2
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ's mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-XP2 sub-controller: the pads, pad modes, loops and deck buttons of openDJ's DDJ-FLX6 mapping, moved to the DDJ-XP2's messages from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list and rekordbox's mapping file.
